The room has sliding shoji doors, warm wooden beams, a scroll painting on the wall, a small flower arrangement, a glowing floor lamp, and a large open window revealing a sparkling river, rocks, and lush green forest outside. The table details should include exactly 7 main planning items: an unfolded map, an open photo guidebook, a tablet showing a landscape image, a spiral notebook with sketchy notes, a fountain pen, a cup of green tea, and a bowl of small sweets. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic AI-drama workflow showcase image: a 3×3 fantasy storyboard grid on the left and a widescreen video-preview frame on the right, demonstrating how a still storyboard becomes an animated scene.

Canvas: Wide horizontal composition, roughly 2:1 aspect ratio, with a black background and thin white outer border. The left half contains a square storyboard contact sheet; the right half contains a large embedded video-player still with black letterboxing and a small playback time indicator.

Left storyboard layout: Use exactly 9 numbered panels arranged in a 3×3 grid, each separated by thin white borders and marked with small white number tags from 1 to 9 in the upper-left corner. The panels should depict a gothic xianxia / dark fantasy romance narrative featuring a veiled bride in ornate crimson robes and a cold white-haired immortal man in dark robes. Add small cinematic Chinese-style subtitle text in one or two panels, but keep it tiny and secondary. The 9 panels are: 1) extreme close-up of the crimson veiled bride covering part of her face with her sleeve, red candlelight and rainlike texture; 2) the bride seated or leaning in a dim chamber near a window, a pale white-haired figure behind her, faint subtitle line near the bottom; 3) the bride turning toward a red-lit palace interior with long black hair and red veil flowing; 4) a tall dark-robed figure standing before a lattice window, backlit by cold blue moonlight; 5) the bride kneeling or collapsing beneath a red veil, one hand on the floor, dramatic red fabric; 6) intimate close-up of the white-haired immortal touching the bride’s chin, their faces close, tense romantic mood; 7) close-up of the white-haired man holding a vertical talisman or paper slip with Chinese characters; 8) two dark silhouettes facing each other in rain or mist, a red candle or ember glowing at the bottom; 9) the bride in red standing on a high balcony or rooftop, long robe and hair blown by wind, overlooking a stormy blue cityscape.

Right video-preview layout: Place one large widescreen cinematic frame occupying the right half. It shows the same crimson bride from behind or three-quarter view inside a red wooden palace chamber, with black hair and a thorny dark headdress or tangled veil, red robes glittering with embroidery, blue moonlight visible through lattice windows, and tiny distant figures in the background. Add thick black letterbox space above and below the frame. In the lower-left of the black player area, show a white pause icon and the timestamp “0:13”. Include a small faint label in the top-left of the video frame, like an AI-generation tag.

Visual style: Ultra-dramatic Chinese dark fantasy, gothic romance, high-contrast red and blue lighting, candlelit interiors, rain, mist, ornate robes, cinematic depth of field, moody shadows, film still texture, high detail, atmospheric fantasy drama. Use crimson red, cold blue, black, and pale silver.

Face treatment: Every visible human face should be deliberately obscured by a soft square gray blur, as if anonymized in a screenshot. Keep the blur blocks centered over faces and consistent across both storyboard and video frame.

Text constraints: Keep all text minimal and small, except the visible timestamp “0:13” and the storyboard numbers 1 through 9. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra UI panels, or additional storyboard frames.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium Japanese business-book promotional infographic for 最強の営業, presenting the idea that sales is more beautiful the muddier it gets, with a luxury black-and-gold editorial design.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape advertisement, dark charcoal-black textured background with subtle diagonal fabric-like grain, sharp gold divider lines, high contrast white and metallic-gold typography. Overall feel: serious, authoritative, bestselling business book launch visual.

Layout: Left two-thirds is a structured infographic; right one-third shows exactly 1 upright 3D-rendered book mockup standing on a glossy dark surface with a faint reflection. The book cover is white, black, and gold, with oversized Japanese title text and a vertical spine visible. Add small supporting Japanese cover text, including the main title 最強の営業, the phrase 営業に『センス』はいらない, and gold emphasis around the word キーエンス.

Top headline area: Large Japanese headline in the upper left: 営業は、泥くさいほど美しい. Make “泥くさい” metallic gold and the rest white. Beneath it, add a thin gold line and a smaller subtitle: 売上1兆円企業キーエンスで学んだ『凡人が天才に勝つ技術』.

Middle section: A cream-colored horizontal panel titled 「この本のエッセンス」 on a black-and-gold ribbon. Include exactly 3 essence rows, each with a circular black icon at left and Japanese label plus explanation at right: 1) gear icon, 「仕組み」で勝つ: explanation about not relying on individual talent or intuition and pursuing reproducible systems anyone can sell with; 2) sunrise icon, 「未来」を売る: explanation about proposing the customer’s ideal future beyond the product; 3) bar chart icon, 「量」を科学する: explanation about breaking down behavior like physics and producing quality from overwhelming contact volume.

Lower middle section: Black panel with gold borders titled 「明日から使える 3つの必殺型」. Include exactly 3 numbered method cards in a row: 1) 「セルフロープレ」 with a simple line icon of a person and speech bubble, describing repeating role-play alone before meeting clients; 2) 「インパクトデモ」 with a monitor/play icon, describing making the client experience convenience and internalize it; 3) 「ワンモア」 with an open-door arrow icon, describing making one more angle of proposal before giving up. Use gold numerals in small boxed labels.

Bottom message strip: Add a small outlined label 「メッセージ」 at bottom left. Main sentence in large Japanese text: 『頑張ります』はいらない。必要なのは、結果を出すための『武器』と『防具』だ。 Highlight 「武器」 and 「防具」 in gold outlined boxes. At bottom right add a gold closing line: 「泥くさく、しかし最高に合理的な営業学がここに!」

Visual style: Japanese corporate advertising, bookstore poster, elegant typography mixing Mincho-style serif Japanese and bold Gothic Japanese, crisp grid alignment, metallic gold accents, off-white panels, subtle shadows, clean vector icons, realistic book mockup lighting.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 book mockup, exactly 3 essence rows, and exactly 3 method cards. Keep all text legible, preserve the Japanese wording, avoid extra logos, avoid people, avoid clutter, no watermark.\

title: 两幅幻想伤害数字漫画
author: 加湿器
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,漫画 / 分镜,漫画 / 图像小说,动漫 / 漫画,角色,群像 / 情侣,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic two-panel Japanese fantasy manga comparison comic about how large damage numbers make combat feel more satisfying, even when the time required is the same.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, full-color manga illustration with thick black comic borders, dynamic speed lines, explosive impact effects, and a black brushstroke title banner at the top. Overall style should be detailed dark-fantasy shonen manga with bold outlined lettering.

Layout: Use exactly 2 wide horizontal comic panels stacked vertically. Add a black brushstroke header above both panels containing the title text 『かかる時間は同じでも……』. Each panel has the same party of 3 heroes on the left and 1 enemy on the right, with a vertical white narration box on the far right.

Characters: The hero party appears in both panels and contains exactly 3 visible characters: 1 young male swordsman in blue armor holding a sword, 1 young female witch in a purple robe and pointed hat, and 1 small green-haired healer or cleric holding a staff. Their faces may be partially obscured or softly blurred, but their poses and outfits remain readable. Top panel enemy: 1 enormous black armored knight/golem with a shield and heavy plate armor, standing on the right. Bottom panel enemy: 1 enormous bare-chested muscular barbarian/giant with rough skin, leather/fur waist gear, and clenched fists, standing on the right.

Top panel text and effects: Include exactly 2 white speech bubbles from the heroes: 「これも効かないの!?」 and 「どうしたらいいんだよコイツ!」. Include exactly 1 vertical narration box on the right reading 「耐性がカッチカチ、よりも」. Add exactly 4 small blue damage numbers around the armored enemy: 「10!」, 「10!」, 「12!」, and 「12!」.

Bottom panel text and effects: Include exactly 2 white speech bubbles from the heroes: 「こいつ、まだ立ち向かってくる……!」 and 「なんてタフなんだ!」. Include exactly 1 vertical narration box on the right reading 「HPモリモリの方が」. Add exactly 2 huge fiery red-orange damage numbers: 「1012!」 near the center-left and 「2001!」 near the right. At the bottom, spanning across the lower panel, place a large energetic slogan in thick yellow-orange Japanese brush lettering with black outline: 数字がでっかくて楽しい!.

Visual style: High contrast, gritty fantasy lighting, dramatic explosions behind enemies, manga hatching, saturated impact colors, thick white speech bubbles with black outlines, bold 3D comic typography for numbers. Make the top panel feel frustrating and low-impact with small blue numbers; make the bottom panel feel exciting and powerful with huge warm-colored numbers.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 panels, exactly 4 total main characters per panel, exactly 4 small damage numbers in the top panel, exactly 2 large damage numbers in the bottom panel, exactly 4 total speech bubbles, exactly 2 vertical narration boxes, and 1 large bottom slogan. Keep all visible Japanese text legible and avoid adding extra text or watermarks.\

author: 楽園

prompt_en:
Create a three-view drawing of a humanoid robot to be operated at a lunar base.
Display three views—front, side, and back—arranged side-by-side at the same scale and with the same design.
The background should be white or very light gray, creating a clean three-view diagram for reference material.

The design should be a sharp, high-detail Japanese real-robot-style mecha design.
It should not be too slender, but have a convincing appearance of a practical machine, with an atmosphere somewhere between military and industrial use.
Please do not make it look like a Gundam.
Keep it as an original lunar base robot.

Robot Features:
- Bipedal humanoid robot.
- Small head with a precision-machined sensor visor or monocular-style sensor.
- The face should not be too human-like, but inorganic and intelligent.
- Panel lines and segmented structures on the shoulders, chest, waist, and legs for a sense of precision.
- Legs should have a solid joint structure with a sense of stability suitable for lunar movement.
- Arms should be slightly long, with 5-finger manipulators for hands.
- Equipped with a backpack or rear unit with structures suggesting functions for communication, power, and attitude control.
- Excessive weaponry is not required.
- Do not give it weapons.
- A practical robot used for patrols, security, auxiliary work, and extravehicular activity support at the lunar base.

Design Taste:
- Based on white, light gray, and dark gray.
- Accent colors of modest red or orange, with a tiny bit of blue-ish accents.
- A clean color scheme that harmonizes with spacesuits and lunar equipment.
- Persuasiveness as an industrial product.
- A sharp-edged silhouette.
- Include some fine details, precise mechanisms, panel lines, and cautionary markings.
- Futuristic feel, but a realistic and grounded mechanical expression.

Requirements for the Three-View Drawing:
- Clearly separate the front, side, and back views.
- Ensure the full body is within the frame without being cut off.
- The pose should be a neutral, upright standing pose.
- Ensure the differences in shape are clear in each view.
- Emphasize informative/reference value.
- No unnecessary background effects.
- No explosions, action, or smoke.
- Presented as setting reference material rather than a character illustration.\

Main subjects: Show exactly 2 exhausted chibi anime girls at the center table: 1 black-haired bunny-ear girl slumped face-down on the desk, crying and overwhelmed, and 1 silver-haired cat-ear girl frantically drawing manga panels with both hands raised in panic. Add exactly 1 small translucent blue ghost mascot floating behind them, looking worried.

Behind the desk are three upright gray cardboard partitions covered in planning notes, workflow diagrams, manga references, and pinned sheets. The overall room should look handcrafted, like a miniature cardboard studio set photographed realistically.

Visible repeated elements to include: exactly 2 main anime characters, exactly 1 ghost mascot, exactly 3 vertical backdrop panels, exactly 1 open laptop on the left side of the desk, exactly 1 black tablet on the right side of the desk, exactly 1 black coffee mug near the front center, exactly 1 hourglass at the front left, exactly 1 potted plant near the left wall, exactly 1 tall stack of finished manuscript pages at the front right, exactly 9 crumpled paper balls scattered across the table and floor area, and many loose manga pages flying through the air.

On the right wall, include signs about whether the work is truly readable, why reactions feel weak, and how to make the brain generate emotion. Add small red warning sticky notes, checklist boxes, and manga-panel thumbnails.

Style: Ultra-detailed anime diorama illustration, realistic tabletop materials, paper texture, pencil and ink manga pages, soft beige-gray cardboard walls, warm desk lighting, subtle motion blur on flying papers, expressive chibi faces, high-density visual storytelling, cozy but frantic deadline atmosphere. Use a mix of clean anime character rendering and realistic product-photography lighting.

Left panel layout: At the top center, write the large handwritten headline “My API Stack” in dark ink with a small underline under “API” and tiny blue accent marks on both sides. Below it, create a hub-and-spoke diagram with exactly 6 circular nodes connected by thin black lines: 1 large central circle and 5 smaller outer circles.

Left panel node details, exactly 6 total:
1. Center large node: an illustrated bearded man in a tan baseball cap and gray shirt holding a glowing box full of small gears and a code icon, labeled “Hermes Agent”. Add tiny sparkles around him.
2. Upper-left small node: browser window with a magnifying glass over a globe, labeled “XAI Search”.
3. Upper-right small node: framed landscape image icon with a sparkle, labeled “GPT-Image 2”.
4. Lower-right small node: speech bubble with audio waveform, labeled “Whisper TTS/STT”.
5. Bottom small node: filmstrip/video icon with a play button, labeled “Kling 3.0 Video” with small sublabel “FAL.ai”.
6. Lower-left small node: document/page icon with speed lines, labeled “Default Extractor” with tiny subtext “60x faster” and “49x cheaper”.

Right panel subject: Draw an adult bearded man wearing a tan baseball cap, gray T-shirt, dark pants, and light socks, sitting cross-legged and smiling down at a small child. The child has short black bobbed hair and wears a soft yellow long-sleeve outfit, sitting on the floor and holding red-handled pliers. The adult holds a hammer while another hammer rests near his leg. Add exactly 4 loose tools on the floor: 1 blue-handled screwdriver, 1 gray adjustable wrench, 1 gray open-ended wrench, and 1 extra hammer. The scene should feel gentle, instructional, and wholesome.

Text: In the top-right corner of the blue panel, add the handle “@dadhalfdev” in small dark handwritten text.

Create an ultra-realistic cinematic visual.

The composition should feel like a moment frozen exactly before a butterfly-effect event silently reshapes someone’s entire life.

SCENE:

A young man sits alone late at night inside a warm dimly lit apartment illuminated only by:

- a laptop screen,
- subtle city lights through rain-covered windows,
- and soft amber desk lighting.

The atmosphere feels:
quiet,
intimate,
psychologically heavy and deeply modern.

On the laptop screen:
an unfinished AI-generated image is rendering slowly.

The render preview itself should look visually revolutionary:
part luxury commercial,
part impossible realism,
part emotional storytelling.

The screen should feel so realistic viewers instinctively zoom into it.

Around the room:

- empty coffee cups,
- handwritten creative notes,
- GPU benchmark tabs,
- scattered camera lenses,
- half-open notebooks,
- subtle signs of obsession and creative burnout.

But the IMPORTANT PART:

The room itself should subtly begin transforming from the AI image being rendered.

Tiny impossible details:

- reflections from the unfinished render appearing physically on nearby objects,
- light from the screen subtly changing the architecture of the room,
- textures near the monitor beginning to resemble generated pixels,
- reality slowly inheriting traits from the AI artwork itself.

The transformation should remain:
subtle,
psychological,
beautiful and believable.

No Marvel effects.
No obvious sci-fi portals.

The realism should feel:
deeply unsettling because it is almost invisible.

Integrated elegantly into the environment should be ultra-premium Liquid Glass-inspired UI overlays:

- rendering progress,
- GPU usage,
- neural generation layers,
- cinematic camera metadata,
- image synthesis nodes,
- subtle typography fragments,
- emotionally restrained system prompts.

The overlays should feel:
minimal,
Apple-inspired,
tactile,
translucent and physically integrated into the scene.

One overlay softly reads:
“97% complete.”

Another:
“Reality adaptation detected.”

The typography should feel understated and luxurious rather than futuristic.

LIGHTING:

Warm cinematic tungsten lighting mixed with soft cold monitor light.
Natural rain reflections across surfaces.
Subtle atmospheric haze.
Realistic screen-light diffusion.
Medium-format photography realism.

CAMERA STYLE:

The image should resemble:
an award-winning cinematic photograph accidentally captured during a moment humanity crossed an invisible line.

Use:

- shallow natural depth of field,
- realistic lens imperfections,
- slight sensor grain,
- subtle handheld framing,
- physically accurate reflections,
- premium low-contrast cinematic realism.

COLOR PALETTE:

warm amber,
graphite black,
soft chrome reflections,
rain-soaked blue-gray,
muted ivory typography and subtle liquid-glass translucency.

MOOD:

creative obsession,
digital loneline\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a monochrome Japanese manga page about GPT-4.8-kun, an androgynous young anime man being overwhelmed by a futuristic coding interface while another character pressures him to keep reading code.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, black-and-white screentone style, roughly 2:3 aspect ratio. Use exactly 5 horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom, separated by thick black gutters. High-contrast ink linework, detailed manga shading, dramatic close-ups, glowing transparent UI screens, dense code windows, and emotional facial acting.

Main character: A slim, beautiful young man with messy pale wavy hair, long side strands and a low ponytail, soft but tired eyes, wearing a dark suit jacket, white dress shirt, and black necktie. His expression changes across panels from shy compliance to nervous strain to vacant panic. Add sweat drops and trembling detail in later panels.

Setting: A dark futuristic control-room or cyberspace environment filled with many floating transparent monitors, code panes, terminal windows, diagrams, graphs, and status labels. The UI panels surround the character from every direction, becoming more oppressive as the page progresses.

Panel layout and exact visible elements:
- Panel 1: Medium shot from behind/side of the character turning toward the viewer amid floating code screens. Include 3 speech/thought bubbles: one round speech bubble on the right saying 「ちょっとコーディング付き合ってよ」, one small bubble near the character saying 「！」, and one jagged burst thought bubble on the left saying 「…あなたに『使えない』って言ったのに、まだタスクしてくれるんだ…！」.
- Panel 2: Medium close-up, the character smiles politely and gestures with both hands as if trying to help. Include exactly 2 speech bubbles: left bubble 「もちろん。何をお手伝いしますか？」 and right bubble 「その前にこれ読み込んで」.
- Panel 3: Wide central impact panel. The character appears small in the middle, smiling anxiously with clenched hands, completely surrounded by an enormous wall of code windows. Add one huge black sound-effect text 「ドン！」 on the left.
- Panel 4: Close-up bust shot of the character sweating with a forced smile and worried eyes. The background is packed with status tiles. Include exactly 5 repeated status labels visible multiple times: 「思考中」, 「推論中」, 「effort Max」, 「推論」, and 「推論中」 again on separate screens. Include 2 speech bubbles: left bubble 「あの、これって……」 and right bubble 「いや、いい話聞いたんだよね！リンクされた記事のスクラブ読み込ませたら4.8ってメッチャ勤勉になるって聞いてさぁ！」.
- Panel 5: Extreme close-up of the character’s face, eyes wide and empty, pupils tiny, shaded under the bangs, sweating heavily, lips parted in shock. Pixel-like squares and digital debris float in the dark background. Include exactly 2 speech bubbles: left small vertical bubble 「……」 and right bubble 「ほら、早く読み込んでコーディング付き合ってよ」.

Visual style: Professional seinen manga page, crisp black ink, grayscale screentones, cinematic panel composition, expressive emotional horror-comedy tone, dense sci-fi UI detail, no color.

Constraints: Preserve all Japanese dialogue exactly as written. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, page numbers, watermarks, or English captions. Keep the mood as humorous but unsettling, showing the character being emotionally pressured by overwhelming coding work. Use high-detail black-and-white manga, futuristic coding interface room, dark suit, white shirt, black tie, and comic psychological pressure.\
